name: Volume Domain Transformation for Rectangular Slicing
definition: A preprocessing step that transforms the original Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) volume domain V into a transformed domain V' to ensure all cutting sections are rectangles, simplifying LTC-based integration and avoiding complex polygon clipping.
summary: Volume Domain Transformation for Rectangular Slicing rotates and expands an AABB volume to guarantee rectangular cross-sections, avoiding complex polygon clipping and simplifying LTC-based integration.
